description: This file implements the Client class for IPC communication within the Rialto server manager, handling session server state changes, configuration, ping, and log level adjustments via gRPC-like calls over IPC channels.

classes.name: Client
classes.description: Handles IPC communication with the Rialto session server, managing state, configuration, ping, and log levels.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes IPC connection and subscribes to events.

methods.name: performSetState
methods.description: Sends a request to set the session server state.

methods.name: performSetConfiguration
methods.description: Sends a request to set the session server configuration.

methods.name: performPing
methods.description: Sends a ping request to the server.

methods.name: setLogLevels
methods.description: Updates the log levels on the server.

methods.name: onStateChangedEvent
methods.description: Handles state change events received from the server.

methods.name: onAckEvent
methods.description: Handles acknowledgment events received from the server.
